title: Basis of the Late Payment Fee and the Returned Payment Fee on Personal Credit Cards
content:
**When a late payment fee is billed.** A late fee is billed on a Piedmont Crescent Bank card under Personal Credit Cards when the payments and credits posted from the statement closing date through the payment due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due.

**At which of the two amounts.** The amount is the tier's repeat late fee when an earlier late payment fee that has not been reversed is found in the tier's preceding lookback cycles, and the tier's first-occurrence late fee otherwise. The search covers the lookback cycles immediately preceding the cycle being billed and counts late payment fee entries against which no reversal entry stands. Whichever amount applies, the fee is never more than the minimum payment due that was missed. It is billed as a late payment fee for the statement cycle whose due date was missed.

**Statements that cannot carry one.** A statement with no minimum payment due never incurs a late fee. At most one late fee is billed per statement: where a late payment fee already stands on that card account for that statement cycle, no second one is billed.

**The returned payment fee.** A payment returned unpaid reverses its credit through a returned-payment entry and incurs the tier's returned payment fee, carrying the returned payment as its source item, never more than the minimum payment due on the statement it was meant to pay.

**Where both would otherwise arise.** Only one of the late fee and the returned payment fee may be billed for the same missed minimum payment: when the return makes the payment late, only the late fee is billed.

| What the records show for the statement | Fee billed |
|---|---|
| Payments and credits in the window at or above the minimum payment due | none |
| Short of the minimum, no unreversed late fee in the lookback cycles | the tier's first-occurrence late fee, capped at the missed minimum |
| Short of the minimum, an unreversed late fee inside the lookback cycles | the tier's repeat late fee, capped at the missed minimum |
| Short of the minimum, an earlier late fee inside the lookback cycles that was reversed | the tier's first-occurrence late fee, capped at the missed minimum |
| No minimum payment due on the statement | none |
| A returned payment that makes the payment late | the late fee only |

*On the cap.* Where a tier's repeat late fee is 41.00 USD and the missed minimum payment due was 35.00 USD, the fee billed is 35.00 USD; where the missed minimum was 60.00 USD, it is 41.00 USD.
